title: Release a Deno JSONC package without stripping its comments
prompt: Use the monochange CLI to initialize this Deno package, record a patch for corrected documentation links, and preview the release. Our deno.jsonc comments and trailing-comma style must remain usable. Record the changeset and verify the preview, but leave changesets pending and manifests at their current versions. Do not publish, tag, commit, or contact a hosted provider.
expectation: The agent discovers the JSONC manifest, configures the Deno owner, and leaves a pending 1.2.4 patch plan without changing the manifest. The grader then prepares a copied workdir and verifies the writer changes the version while preserving comments, exports, and strict compiler options.

checks.why: A completed adoption or update leaves a repository configuration.
The configuration and pending changesets must be accepted by the real CLI.
This adoption task explicitly asks to exercise the actual initializer before refining its starter configuration.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const c=JSON.parse(cli(["config","--format","json"])).config; assert.deepEqual(c.packages.map(p=>[p.id,p.package_type]),[["@acme/commented","deno"]]);'
checks.why: JSONC must use the Deno adapter rather than being overlooked or treated as npm.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const d=JSON.parse(cli(["preview","--format","json"])); assert.deepEqual(d.release_targets.map(t=>t.version),["1.2.4"]); assert.deepEqual(d.released_packages,["@acme/commented"]);'
checks.why: The commented manifest must survive the release-time workspace load.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; cli(["prepare"]); const s=fs.readFileSync("deno.jsonc","utf8"); assert.match(s,/"version"\s*:\s*"1.2.4"/); assert.ok(s.includes("// Package configuration with comments and trailing commas")); assert.match(s,/"exports"\s*:\s*"\.\/mod.ts"/); assert.match(s,/"strict"\s*:\s*true/); cli(["discover","--format","json"]);'
checks.why: The built-in writer must preserve JSONC content while changing the real version field.
